# TallyJ 4 — why it is built this way

TallyJ 4 is a full-stack election management and ballot tallying system for Bahá’í communities. This site publishes the reasoning behind its code: decisions, rejected alternatives and constraints that the code alone cannot explain, kept in the repository's [`context/`](https://github.com/glittle/TallyJ-4/tree/main/context) directory with [Keep the Why](https://keepthewhy.com).

- **[Read the context](context/index.md)**: one page per topic, straight from `context/`.
- **[Open the dashboard](https://glittle.github.io/TallyJ-4/dashboard/live/)**: the topics and the references between them as a graph, each entry with its Git history, and what still needs a person.

Source code, setup and usage: [github.com/glittle/TallyJ-4](https://github.com/glittle/TallyJ-4).
